Smart Cleaner analyzes accessible shared-storage file metadata and, when needed for duplicate detection, on-device content fingerprints. These cleaner-engine fingerprints and personal files are not uploaded by Smart Cleaner.

All files access is requested because file management and maintenance are core features: scanning and managing junk, duplicates, large files, downloads, APK installers and WhatsApp media across shared storage. Android continues to block other apps’ protected private data directories.

Usage Access is optional and is used to read app storage/cache statistics and last-used timestamps. App Cache Manager invokes Android’s official cache-cleaning system action and Android controls the required confirmation.

Files are removed only after user selection or an Android system confirmation.

Smart Cleaner does not include a third-party crash-reporting service. File names, paths, file contents and duplicate fingerprints are not uploaded for crash reporting.

Smart Cleaner keeps preferences and aggregate scan/cleanup history only in local app storage until you clear app data or uninstall the app. Most files you clean first move to Smart Cleaner’s Trash on this device and can be restored there for 7 days; files deleted permanently, and Trash once it is emptied, cannot be restored. Google retains data it processes under its published policies.
